prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual production pixel-art game character sprite sheet, not a concept painting.
Input image: style reference and approved appearance target. Match its charming detailed faces, volumetric hair, full shoulders and torso, garment shading, trim, buttons, and distinct shaded boots. NO skinny stick body, NO long featureless column legs. Original adult farmer proportions like the reference, head about one quarter of total height.
Create a perfectly regular transparent FOUR COLUMN BY FOUR ROW sheet (exactly 16 separate full-body people). Canvas 1024 by 1536; every cell is exactly 256 by 384, no gutters, no grid lines, no text. Each person centered within its own cell, boots at identical baseline with small 16px bottom margin; all people the same apparent height and scale. Feet must never meet the next cell. Row 1 faces camera/down; row 2 faces away/up (NO face visible); row 3 strict profile facing LEFT; row 4 strict profile facing RIGHT.
Artwork should be an enlarged 32x48 native pixel sprite per cell: clearly visible square pixel clusters, crisp opaque pixel silhouette with genuinely transparent empty space, no antialias, no blurry shading, no shadows/background/ground, no props. Use detailed but clean 3-4 tone ramps for skin/hair/clothes, large visible eyes with whites and dark pupils, nose, rosy cheeks, tousled or layered hair, separate arms/hands at waist height, muscular non-stick trouser legs, boot tops and soles. Fit roughly 24x44 native pixels centered in the 32x48 cell. Relaxed standing pose, both boots grounded. Preserve strong detailed reference resemblance at native size.
OUTFIT: cream rolled-sleeve shirt under dark teal denim bib overalls; brass clasps, breast pocket, waistband, trouser seams, brown work boots
Columns 1-4 show the same outfit and body with four hairstyles: 1 short tousled black hair; 2 short swept copper-red hair; 3 chestnut brown long braid; 4 golden blond shoulder-length waves. Keep face/skin/outfit/scale identical between columns, change only hair.
